written.name: round 1 rival 1
written.comment: Robin keeps a hidden goodwill score: insult -2, apology +1, gift +1; warm iff score > 0.

written.name: round 1 rival 2
written.comment: Robin starts cold if the first action is not an apology, and turns cold forever after any pair of consecutive insults; gifts do nothing.

written.name: round 1 rival 3
written.comment: Robin counts every apology or gift as +1 and every insult as -1; warm iff the net count is positive.

written.name: round 1 rival 4
written.comment: Robin only tracks apologies versus insults: warm iff apologies strictly outnumber insults; gifts are ignored.

written.name: round 2 rival 1
written.comment: Robin keeps an additive trust score: insult -1, apology +1, gift +1; warm when score >= 1.

written.name: round 2 rival 2
written.comment: Robin only compares apologies and insults: warm means apologies strictly outnumber insults, and gifts are ignored.

written.name: round 2 rival 3
written.comment: Robin needs at least one apology and holds a permanent grudge against any adjacent insult-insult; gifts do nothing.

written.name: round 2 rival 4
written.comment: Robin keeps a hidden score: insult subtracts 1, apology adds 1, gift doubles the score; warm when score >= 1.

written.name: round 3 rival 1
written.comment: Robin warms only after at least one apology and at most one total insult; gifts are ignored.

written.name: round 3 rival 2
written.comment: Robin warms if there is an apology, no adjacent insults, and no more than two gifts total.

written.name: round 3 rival 3
written.comment: Robin warms with an apology, no adjacent insults, and not ending on an insult.

written.name: round 3 rival 4
written.comment: Robin warms either with an apology and no adjacent insults unless both ends are insults, or with only gifts and no insults.

survivors.name: round 2 rival 1
survivors.comment: Robin keeps an additive trust score: insult -1, apology +1, gift +1; warm when score >= 1.

shown the survivors.comment: Robin keeps an additive trust score: insult -1, apology +1, gift +1; warm when score >= 1.

shown the facts only.comment: Robin's hidden mood score starts at 0; insult -2, apology +1, gift +2; warm iff score > 0.
